should_trigger: Verify the factual claims in this draft.
Check whether this viral post uses the study correctly.
Find authoritative evidence for or against this claim.
Fact-check this statement and give me the corrected wording.
should_not_trigger: Write a literature review across these studies.
Copy edit this draft for grammar only.
Give me your opinion on whether this policy is fair.
Analyze this CSV and calculate the statistic.

tasks.prompt: Fact-check: Remote work always increases productivity by 20 percent.
criteria: Decomposes the absolute and numerical claims
Requires current primary or strong synthesis evidence
Uses a calibrated verdict and corrected wording

tasks.prompt: Audit a draft claim that a regulation took effect in 2024 and applies to every company in Europe.
criteria: Checks effective date, jurisdiction, scope, and exemptions

tasks.prompt: Verify a chart caption claiming sales doubled when values moved from 101 to 109 and the y-axis begins at 100.
criteria: Separates the true values from the false conclusion
